work.name: Stony Brook University
responsibilities: Engineered a PyTorch multiprocessing harness that increased synthetic data generation throughput by 30% utilizing idle GPUs through process-based parallelism.

Architected a standardized pipeline to test robotic models in simulated environments that cut testing cycles by 20%.

work.name: PACE Lab
responsibilities: Developed the Tensor Parallel implementation for Mamba SSMs, achieving up to 4.0x throughput over FSDP on multi-GPU nodes.
Built a multi-threaded inference server for Mamba SSMs that cut end-to-end latency by 50% over naive HuggingFace transformers loading, via optimized weight loading and tensor transport.
Created a hybrid parallel strategy for SSMs to mitigate the collective communication bottleneck in multi-GPU nodes; Achieved 10% higher average throughput than TP.

work.name: NeoDocs (YC S21)

Developed a hybrid storage architecture syncing live Firestore writes to an eventually consistent MongoDB replica, offloading OLAP queries and attaining 99.99% sync service uptime.
Redesigned DB schema to eliminate O(N) in-memory collection scans to reduce cron job memory usage by 75%.
additionalResponsibilities: Spearheaded a team of 3 to develop a cross-platform mobile app that reached 100K+ downloads and 35K+ monthly active users, achieving an average rating of 4.3 stars.
Architected an OpenCV WASM SDK that standardized image capture to 95% consistency across diverse cameras and lighting conditions; increased prototyping velocity by 20%.
Led the transition from Firebase to a fault-tolerant MongoDB query server, reducing read latency by 10x with zero downtime during cutover.
Architected a camera plugin with CV-driven exposure control that pre-filtered non-conformant frames, cutting the user retake rate by 95% (from ~35% to <2%).

work.name: NeoDocs (YC S21)
responsibilities: Built an on-device caching and syncing layer that enabled offline access for 90% of basic functionality and reduced server load by 40% through request batching.
Deployed edge ML on mobile via quantized TFLite models, decreasing bad image captures by 90%.
Engineered a server-driven UI system with local caching that enabled rapid A/B testing of cross-selling ad strategies without client redeployments.
additionalResponsibilities: Developed scripts used to validate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for investors, providing data for the company's $2M Seed.

projects.name: surus: Hybrid LLM Memory Engine
projects.description: A 4-backend hybrid retrieval engine for long-term LLM memory, fusing semantic, lexical, temporal, and graph signals.
highlights: Designing a 4-backend hybrid memory engine fusing Qdrant (filterable HNSW), Tantivy (BM25), DuckDB (temporal range), and Neo4j+GDS (spreading-activation PageRank) via RRF and cross-encoder reranking.

Built a bi-temporal validity model that records when a fact became true, when it was invalidated, and when the contradiction was learned, enabling correct point-in-time queries over evolving knowledge.
[Pending benchmark] Achieved x% on the LoCoMo long-term memory benchmark (Phase 0 oracle baseline).

projects.name: lazyssh: SSH Workflow Manager
projects.description: A Go-based TUI + headless CLI for managing SSH hosts, with always-on connection multiplexing and an agent-controllable interface.
highlights: Built a Go-based SSH workflow manager (TUI + headless CLI) where every spawned connection auto-multiplexes, skipping repeat 2FA prompts and cutting per-connect latency by 30-60%.
Designed an atomic ssh_config writer with rolling backups and order/comment/indent preservation, plus a self-healing TOML sidecar that round-trips host renames.
Exposed every TUI action as a versioned-JSON CLI subcommand to enable headless agent (Claude Code, MCP) control of remote SSH workflows.

projects.name: Domin: Synthetic Data Generator
projects.description: A Python package that orchestrates high-throughput data generation from a single config file.
highlights: Developed a Python package that orchestrates high-throughput data generation from a single config file.
Implemented an asynchronous scheduler with retry-on-failure logic that completes the full target sample count under transient simulation failures.

projects.name: Mako: Read-Path Optimization on a Spanner-like Database
projects.description: Course extension to a Spanner-like, geo-replicated OLTP database, focused on read-path performance.
highlights: Designed and implemented a read-only fast path for a Spanner-like, geo-replicated OLTP database, achieving 3.4x higher read throughput.
Used Snapshot Isolation with Follower Reads to enable linear read scalability and eliminate read-only aborts.

projects.name: Symbiosis AI
highlights: Built a LangGraph multi-agent pipeline that consumes streamed posts from the text-based social platform series.so via a Kafka queue.
Backed the agent graph with a Redis-based memory layer that serializes per-user traits into persistent profiles for continuity across conversations.

projects.name: whatsinmypg: AI-Native PostgreSQL Extension
projects.description: A PostgreSQL extension written in C++ that adds no-maintenance GenAI querying functionality using Clickhouse's AI SDK
highlights: Eliminated per-query schema lookups against Postgres by maintaining an in-process schema cache refreshed out-of-band on DDL changes.
Verified zero throughput overhead vs baseline Postgres via pgbench at 200 concurrent connections on a 1M-row database.

projects.name: Raft KV Store

highlights: Engineered a fault-tolerant KV store implementing Leader Election and Log Replication per the Raft protocol.
Implemented request batching to reduce RPCs by 20% and enable recovery of lagging followers up to 80% faster.

projects.name: Perftop & WrapFS: Low-Level Systems Lab

highlights: Developed a custom kernel module to profile process scheduling via kernel hooks, capturing context-switch metrics.
Patched a bug in Wrapfs (Stackable File System) where access control lists failed to propagate to child inodes.

projects.name: Challenges Studio - Holistic SWE Evaluation Platform
projects.description: AI-native real-world evaluation platform for new grad SWEs

Wrote a custom Fastify.js plugin with LRU eviction over active container sessions, bounding server memory under concurrent user load.

projects.name: Spotifind: AI Navigation for the Visually Impaired
projects.description: Voice-activated AI navigation system for the visually impaired with integrated prescription management. Won HopperHacks 2025 (Healthcare Track) and HackNYU 2025 (Streamlit Track).

Built a real-time voice-activated navigation pipeline combining YOLO v12 object detection (80+ classes), Depth Anything depth mapping, and semantic segmentation to deliver obstacle-free guidance.
Layered a prescription-management subsystem on top - OCR-based prescription upload, medicine-bottle recognition, and multilingual support via Google Gemini (100+ languages).

projects.name: Encoder-LM Fine-Tuning for Humor Preference Ranking

Built a few-shot prompt evaluation pipeline to benchmark base-model alignment against the crowdsourced ground-truth rankings.

projects.name: researchGPT: AI-Powered Research Assistant

Shipped the system end-to-end behind a custom Flask server in 48 hours, alongside a 3-person team.

publications.name: Scaling State-Space Models on Multiple GPUs with Tensor Parallelism
publications.summary: Communication-efficient tensor parallelism for selective SSM inference. Reports 1.6-2.1x throughput on 2 GPUs and 2.6-4.0x on 4 GPUs over FSDP, plus 10-18% gains from quantized AllReduce. With Anurag Dutt, Hazem Masarani, and Anshul Gandhi.
